summary: Oncolytics Biotech filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 furnishing a press release dated September 10, 2026, disclosing positive preclinical results for pelareorep combined with a pan-RAS inhibitor in a RAS-driven colorectal cancer model. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; the item is furnished, not filed, under Section 18. The event is a routine scientific/clinical update, not a special situation. Watch for dosing-optimization and clinical-trial design updates as the operative catalyst rather than any deal mechanics.
